summaries.summary: The slide presents insights on .RO smartphone and data consumption, focusing on social media platforms' market share in Romania in 2013 and mobile Facebook users in October 2014. It includes a bar chart showing social media network usage in Romania (2013) and a donut chart illustrating the OS split among mobile Facebook users in October 2014, with Android, Windows Mobile, and iOS represented by different colors.

5.4 million mobile Facebook users in October 2014.
